I expect Joe Binks, with his usual slick publicity methods will soon get another to replace this, but at the time of writing all we know is that the race will be held, but that's about all.

Dumbrill, in Hampshire, also met Joe Binks lecturing the troops. Albert Wattam, Lincolnshire and Brighton road fame, writes:—"My old place was practically destroyed by enemy action in November last." Our deepest sympathies, Albert, but we are very pleased that you are still standing up and smiling.
Bill Merryman, still in Staffordshire, is hoping to once again bring a team south to run " around Joe Binks' houses." Has been winning prizes in his Unit sports.
Bill Merryman, still in Staffs, brought a team to London for Joe Binks' Whit Monday meeting, and his C.O. was very pleased with their performance.
